author: idea-expander
summary: Gradient-norm-inverse per-layer LR outperforms uniform LR on MNIST MLP
claim: Scaling each layer's learning rate inversely proportional to its gradient norm (high-gradient layers receive lower LR) achieves higher final validation accuracy than uniform SGD LR on a 3-layer MLP trained on MNIST.

author: idea-expander
summary: Geometric depth-decay LR (deeper layers = smaller LR) improves MNIST MLP accuracy
claim: Setting LR_l = base_lr * gamma^l (gamma=0.5, l=layer index from input) so shallower layers learn faster than deeper layers yields higher final validation accuracy on MNIST than a uniform learning rate.

author: idea-expander
summary: PID-controller per-layer LR (control-theory transplant) converges faster than Adam on MNIST MLP
claim: A PID-inspired per-layer learning rate controller — modulating each layer's LR using proportional (current gradient norm), integral (exponential moving average of gradient norm), and derivative (change in gradient norm) terms — achieves higher validation accuracy after 10 epochs than Adam with a global uniform LR on a 3-layer MNIST MLP.

author: idea-expander
summary: Layer-wise LR reduces epochs needed to first reach 97% val accuracy vs uniform LR on MNIST MLP
claim: The best layer-wise LR strategy found by grid search (across gradient-norm-inverse, geometric decay, and linear ramp variants) reaches 97% MNIST validation accuracy in fewer epochs than the best uniform SGD LR baseline.
